# Docs Boilerplate

> Reusable agent-first Docs-as-Code generator. The source of truth is Markdown and a composable catalog; Docsify is an optional browser viewer.

## Start here

- [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Generator overview](README.md)
- [Documentation index](docs/index.md)
- [Generator CLI](docs/generator.md)
- [Implementation and verification status](docs/implementation-status.md)
- [Documentation standard](catalog/base/docs/standards/documentation.md)

## Architecture and choices

- [Architecture](docs/architecture/index.md)
- [Accepted design decisions](docs/decisions/index.md)
- [Open template decisions](docs/decisions/owner-decision-backlog.md)

The catalog includes only reusable scaffolds and selected-technology guidance. A generated repository is a separate project's documentation, not a copy of this maintainer repository.
